date_note: Release day of the report as stated by Daily Mirror (Sri Lanka), published 25 November.
title: House committees' report says Chinese AI models are in U.S. companies and sought for PLA cyber systems, per Daily Mirror
org: House Homeland Security Committee and House Select Committee on China
summary: Daily Mirror reports that the House Homeland Security Committee and the House Select Committee on China released a report on 20 November. It says investigators found Chinese AI models in Airbnb, DoorDash and the Cursor coding platform, and that a July 2026 PLA procurement sought DeepSeek integration for a cyber training environment. Airbnb and DoorDash said they run the models on American infrastructure.
plain: Two House committees say Chinese AI models are used inside U.S. firms, and that PLA procurement sought DeepSeek for cyber training. The companies say they host the models in the U.S.
exec: Congress is scrutinising Chinese AI models in U.S. products, which may bring restrictions.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The report, as Daily Mirror relays it, recommends disclosure of embedded AI models and limits on Chinese models in high-risk critical infrastructure.

validation.note: Only Daily Mirror was read; the committees' report itself could not be found by search.
